name: Resident Evil: Relict
source:
2001. Several years have passed since the Raccoon City Incident. The Umbrella Corporation, which was behind biological weapons development that caused many incidents in the past, is on the brink of destruction. Perhaps, the most important session in Raccoon Trials is coming soon.

Claire Redfield, a survivor of those horrific events, her brother Chris and other familiar faces were invited to a party in a newly built skyscraper called "Relict" to celebrate their victory. But they couldn't imagine what nightmare awaits them there. Steel walls of "Relict" became their deadly prison and a new threat emerges from the darkness below. A massive skyscraper could hide mysteries beyond description... What evil do these walls conceal?

[From [url=https://anvell.itch.io/residentevilrelict]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2001年，距离浣熊市事件已过去数年。曾暗中研发生物武器、导致一系列惨剧的保护伞公司，如今已濒临覆灭。浣熊市审判中或许最重要的一次庭审，也即将到来。

那些恐怖事件的幸存者克莱尔·雷德菲尔德、她的哥哥克里斯，以及其他熟悉的面孔，受邀前往新建的“Relict”摩天大楼，参加庆祝胜利的聚会。然而，他们无法想象，那里等待着怎样的噩梦。大楼的钢铁墙壁化作致命牢笼，新的威胁从下方的黑暗中浮现。如此庞大的摩天大楼，足以藏下难以言喻的秘密…这些墙壁之内，究竟潜藏着怎样的邪恶？

[摘自[url=https://anvell.itch.io/residentevilrelict]Itch.io[/url]]
